run_scope: Strict-lane review and one endpoint-continuation score-surface preflight. No dot placement, holdout scoring, TIFF writing, leaderboard submission, or slot selection.
hypothesis: A sufficiently elongated visible catalogue fault trace may continue beneath cover beyond its mapped endpoint; locally project its endpoint tangent and predict only outside a 300 m catalogue exclusion.
mechanism: For each visible 8-connected catalogue component, estimate the principal orientation and local tangent at both ends; emit a decaying candidate score surface from 325 m to 1.5 km beyond the endpoints. The preflight surface uses only the owner-mirrored catalogue raster and was masked to more than 300 m from the full visible catalogue.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, intrusive/dike boundaries, erosional truncations, structural intersections, and map-sheet/digitising boundaries can terminate or mimic a mapped fault trace.
data_provenance: data/grid/labels.tif is hash-pinned to an owner-maintained mirror, but organizer-origin authentication was not established in this session.
